title: Vertical ties.
officialText:
Each column and each wall carrying vertical load shall be vertically tied continuously from its lowest to
highest level. The vertical ties composed of vertical column reinforcement shall be capable of resisting a tensile force equal to
the maximum design dead and live load received by the column or wall from any one story within four floors below.
